title: Evidence-Linked Radiology Reporting: A Human-Supervised Reference Architecture for Structured Imaging Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2605.25120v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Radiology reports remain the primary mechanism by which imaging findings are communicated to clinical teams. However, much of the structured information behind these reports, including measurements, image evidence, prior comparisons, lesion identity, uncertainty, and terminology, often remains trapped in free text or fragmented across picture archiving and communication systems, radiology information systems, reporting workstations, worksheets, advanced visualization tools, and electronic health records. This paper proposes a human-supervised, evidence-linked reference architecture for structured radiology reporting. The framework combines exam-specific templates, speech-to-structure processing, measurement and segmentation capture, controlled AI-assisted drafting, and standards-based interoperability using DICOM, DICOM Structured Reporting, DICOM Segmentation, HL7 FHIR, RadLex, SNOMED CT, LOINC, and UCUM. translated_title: 循证关联的放射学报告：一种面向结构化影像智能的人机监督参考架构
translated_abstract: 放射学报告仍然是向临床团队传达影像检查结果的主要机制。然而，这些报告背后的许多结构化信息，包括测量值、影像证据、既往检查对比、病灶身份、不确定性以及术语，往往被困在自由文本中，或分散在影像归档与通信系统（PACS）、放射学信息系统（RIS）、报告工作站、工作清单、高级可视化工具和电子健康记录（EHR）中。本文提出了一种面向结构化放射学报告的、人机监督且证据关联的参考架构。该框架结合了针对特定检查的模板、语音转结构化处理、测量与分割捕获、受控的AI辅助草拟，以及基于标准（DICOM、DICOM结构化报告、DICOM分割、HL7 FHIR、RadLex、SNOMED CT、LOINC和UCUM）的互操作性。（注：原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种人机监督、证据关联的结构化放射学报告参考架构，通过整合检查专用模板、语音转结构化、测量捕获、受控AI辅助起草以及基于DICOM和HL7 FHIR等标准的互操作性，将分散在各临床系统中的影像信息统一起来。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a human-supervised, evidence-linked reference architecture for structured radiology reporting that unifies imaging information fragmented across clinical systems by integrating exam-specific templates, speech-to-structure processing, measurement capture, controlled AI-assisted drafting, and standards-based interoperability (DICOM, HL7 FHIR, RadLex, SNOMED CT, LOINC, UCUM).
